title: Dalai Lama meets John Mack about aliens

tellings.quote: The Dalai Lama also met with Harvard psychiatrist John Mack about aliens and expressed a similar companionship of worldviews.

plain: In the 1990s the Dalai Lama is said to have met the Harvard psychiatrist John Mack, who studied people who said they had been taken by aliens, to talk about aliens. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and says the Dalai Lama showed a "similar companionship of worldviews," meaning his outlook and Mack's fit together. He raises it to show that a major religious leader took the subject seriously.
